newsAll.head: Aaron Jones: Practicing again Friday
newsAll.body: Jones (knee) was present for practice Friday, Kevin Seifert of ESPN.com reports.

newsAll.head: DJ Moore: Returns to practice Friday
newsAll.body: Moore (shoulder) was back on the practice field Friday in a red non-contact jersey, Katherine Fitzgerald of The Buffalo News reports.

newsAll.head: Jayden Daniels: Won't go on injured reserve
newsAll.body: Daniels (elbow) won't be placed on injured reserve and is considered week-to-week, per Commanders head coach Dan Quinn.

newsAll.head: Jalen Coker: Listed questionable for Sunday
newsAll.body: Coker (ankle) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game, Steve Reed of the Associated Press reports.

newsAll.head: Tyjae Spears: Limited in Friday's practice
newsAll.body: Spears (ankle) was listed as limited for Friday's practice, Terry McCormick of TitanInsider reports.
